name: VENTIQ Client 001 Structured Intake Regression
purpose: Deterministic pilot fixture specification for the canonical structured-intake pipeline. Contains no real client or investor data.

cases.expected: All 16 canonical operating sheets present with one representative valid row per sheet.
Investor_Master email is blank and should produce REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING during processing.
Fund_Master is absent and should produce REQUIRED_SHEET_MISSING during processing.
Investor_Master contains two rows with the same investor_code and should produce DUPLICATE_SOURCE_KEY warning semantics.

future_e2e_assertions: Matching governed fund accepts valid canonical workbook upload.
Wrong fund context cannot process the batch.
Second upload of the identical valid file is rejected by file-hash duplicate protection.
Valid processing persists source_batch_id, source_sheet_name and source_row_number lineage.
Missing required field is persisted as a reviewable validation issue.
Missing required sheet produces review-required outcome.
Duplicate source key produces deterministic warning handling.
Batch metrics record inserted, updated, rejected and warning counts.
Replay/update path does not silently duplicate economic records.
Structured source_batch_id can continue into the existing Maker/Checker activation workflow.
